# Páramo: full overview

> Your AI transformation partner. Páramo puts AI to work inside growing companies, then makes sure their teams can run it.

## About

Páramo is an AI implementation partner based in the Twin Cities (Minneapolis and St. Paul, Minnesota). It was founded in late 2025 by brothers Dennis Morales (co-founder and CEO) and Adrian Morales (co-founder and COO), who are Colombian. The name comes from the páramo, the high Andean ecosystem above Bogotá whose plants catch fog and feed the rivers below. That is how we work: start with what is already there, shape it into systems, and let it run on its own.

We work with growing companies whose teams are ready for AI, including home services, construction, healthcare, real estate, professional services, accounting, manufacturing, distribution, restaurants, retail and ecommerce. Official partner of OpenAI, DevRev and Jotform. We have connected AI to Gmail, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, QuickBooks, PandaDoc and Slack for clients.

## What we do

### AI Concierge
We sit with owners and CEOs, set up Claude for the way they work, and build the workflows their job needs together, step by step, until they are building their own agentic workflows.

### Team AI Workshops
Hands-on sessions in plain language, built around the tasks a team actually does. A paid workshop runs: assess, plan, a working session (90 minutes, a half day or a full day), done-with-you build hours, and take-home material.

### AI Strategy
We map where hours and money go, then hand over a ranked plan: what to automate now, what can wait, and what to leave alone. Kickoff, interviews, a map of hours and cost per workflow, ranked opportunities, and a decision with the leadership team.

### Fractional Chief AI Officer
Senior AI leadership without a full-time hire: the AI roadmap and priorities, tool and vendor decisions, an AI use policy and training, a monthly leadership meeting, and a quarterly review.

### Managed Agents
Agents built around a business that answer, follow up, report and keep work moving. We pick one job to hand off first, build on the tools already in use, test it alongside the team, launch it, and keep improving it.

## How we work

1. **Audit:** we sit with the people doing the work, map how it actually gets done, and rank opportunities by impact and effort.
2. **Optimize:** we fix the process before adding AI, then build on the tools the team already uses.
3. **Automate:** we run it alongside the team until it runs on its own. Client-facing messages are drafted for a person to approve; automatic sending is a later choice.

## Questions

### Will AI make mistakes with my customers?

It can, which is why nothing goes out without your approval at first. You see what it does, correct it, and only let it run on its own once you trust it.

### Is my data safe?

Each platform has its own AI policy. OpenAI and Anthropic both state that, by default, they do not train their models on data from their business plans or their developer platforms. That covers ChatGPT Business and Enterprise, and Claude Team and Enterprise. Personal plans follow different rules, so we set your team up on business accounts. Your data also stays in your own accounts and the tools you already use.

### My team isn't technical. Will they actually use it?

Yes. Training is part of the work. Your people learn it in plain language, on their own jobs.

### Which AI should we use? We already pay for Microsoft 365 or Google.

Usually Claude or ChatGPT, on a business plan. If you already pay for Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, some AI may already be included, and for part of your team that may be enough. We start with what you already pay for, and only suggest new seats for the people who will use them. And if you do not have any AI yet, we can help with that too.

### Will it work with the software we already use?

Often, yes. We have connected AI to Gmail, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, QuickBooks, PandaDoc and Slack for clients, so nobody has to learn a new platform. Some industry software is harder to reach, so we check before we promise anything and tell you plainly what is possible.

### Will AI replace people on my team?

That is your decision, not the software's. In a 2024 Census Bureau survey, about 95 in 100 businesses using AI reported no change in how many people they employ. Most use it to take repetitive work off the people they already have, so those people have more time for customers and the work that needs them.
